description: Retrieves style usage analytics (insertions, detachments) for a Figma library, grouped by 'style' or 'team'; if providing a date range, ensure end_date is not before start_date.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving style analytics data from a Figma library.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination, from a previous response's `cursor` field to fetch the next page; omit for first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

end_date.description: End date for the analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD). Data includes up to the end of this date's week. Defaults to the most recently computed week if unspecified.
end_date.title: End Date

file_key.description: Unique identifier (key) of the Figma library. Must be a published library file from an Enterprise plan organization.
file_key.title: File Key

group_by.description: Dimension by which to group the library style analytics data. Use 'style' for per-style metrics or 'team' for per-team metrics.
group_by.title: Group By

start_date.description: Start date for the analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD). Data includes from the start of this date's week. Defaults to one year prior if unspecified.
start_date.title: Start Date

inputSchema.title: GetLibraryAnalyticsStyleActionDataRequest

name: get_library_analytics_style_action_data

data.description: Structured analytics data, including rows, `next_page` flag, and `cursor` for pagination if applicable.
data.title: Data

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page, present if `next_page` is true. Use in `cursor` parameter of subsequent requests.
cursor.title: Cursor

next_page.description: Indicates if a subsequent page of data can be fetched.
next_page.title: Next Page

rows.description: Array of analytics data entries. Structure depends on `group_by`: `Row` for 'style', `Row1` for 'team'.
rows.title: Rows

detachments.description: Total times this style was detached during the week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: Total times this style was inserted (applied) during the week.
insertions.title: Insertions

style_key.description: Unique and stable identifier for the style.
style_key.title: Style Key

style_type.description: Type of the style (e.g., FILL, TEXT).
style_type.title: Style Type

week.description: Week identifier for this data row (typically start date of the week, YYYY-MM-DD).
week.title: Week

detachments.description: Total style detachments by this team during the week.
detachments.title: Detachments

insertions.description: Total style insertions (applications) by this team during the week.
insertions.title: Insertions

team_name.description: Name of the team that performed actions with library styles.
team_name.title: Team Name

week.description: Week identifier for this data row (typically start date of the week, YYYY-MM-DD).
week.title: Week

workspace_name.description: Name of the Figma workspace the team belongs to, if applicable.
workspace_name.title: Workspace Name
